summary: Sangrix Inc., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the unwind of a prior private placement. Investors who bought about 66,668 Class A ordinary shares for $6 million in Dogecoin on August 11, 2025 exercised a contractual redemption right on August 20, 2026, returning all 30 million DOGE and receiving cancellation of all shares on September 22, 2026. No price per share, premium, or advisor is stated. Following cancellation, 1,881,935 Class A shares remain outstanding. This is a routine contractual rescission, not a special situation; watch for potential dilution or capital-raising needs.
